state_machine.SAT: Require a complete model and direct evaluation of every augmented clause; report a checked I18 witness or escalate, and learn no cut.
state_machine.UNKNOWN: Timeout, nonstandard exit, malformed transcript, or invalid model; learn no cut and make no satisfiability claim.
state_machine.UNSAT: Require a nonempty proof artifact, but keep UNSAT unchecked until an independent drat-trim replay succeeds.
